_doc: The in-game event islands' story objects (events agent, 2026-10-07; notes/EVENTS.md; format: b2tools/patches/story.py). Emerald tiles ('at') of the named map (pokeemerald, data/hoenn_event_maps.json); uid = 100 + local id outdoors, the local id in rooms. Every object is "optional": the islands are warp-only groups and the Navel Rock caves rooms that a build may leave out (data/hoenn_standalone.json "build", RESERVE[8]); their objects are then skipped, not an error.
